claims.evidence: Photo 0 panel text reads 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' and LG branding visible on top left panel.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Visible rust spots along the top edge and lower front panel near the base are inconsistent with a unit bought new only a year ago.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: No power-on test, spin cycle, or motor/internal view shown in the report.
Documents not shown in any photo; only a printed '10 Year Warranty' emblem on the unit itself is visible.

risks.risk: Rust spots may indicate water exposure, leak history, or age beyond what seller states, possibly affecting structural integrity or internal corrosion.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each rust spot plus a photo of the rear panel and base for corrosion extent.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically and structurally compromised, worst-case rust damage.

risks.risk: Working condition unconfirmed — no power-on, spin, or drain test shown.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on, running a spin cycle, and draining without leaks or unusual noise.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-functional / for-parts until proven working.

risks.risk: Power cord, hoses, and detergent drawer not shown — may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the included power cord, inlet/outlet hoses, and detergent drawer.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete, requiring replacement accessories.

risks.risk: Interior drum condition and cleanliness unknown; could affect hygiene or indicate heavy prior use.
risks.proof: Photo of the open drum interior and door seal/gasket.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown interior condition, assume needs cleaning/servicing.

risks.risk: Seller's 'barely used/bought last year' claim is inconsistent with visible rust, raising doubt about true age/usage history.
risks.proof: Photo of purchase receipt with date and photo of warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an older/heavier-used unit than claimed.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of all rust spots, including rear and base panels
Video of the machine powered on through a full wash and spin cycle
Photo of power cord, inlet/outlet hoses, and detergent drawer
Photo of open drum interior and door seal
Photo of receipt and warranty card showing purchase date
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an LG 7kg DirectDrive front-loader, but visible rust contradicts the 'barely used' claim and functional condition is unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
